title: [Expense Agent] Renumber codeunits that collide with deprecated country apps
summary: Three Expense Agent codeunits are renumbered from 6913-6915 to 6923-6925 to avoid collisions with deprecated country-specific Expense Agent apps that cause installation failures on thousands of tenants.
key_points: Expense Agent Quota Impl. moves from 6913 to 6923
No Receipt Declaration Mgt. moves from 6915 to 6925
Travel Req. Linked Reports moves from 6914 to 6924
Fixes production hotfix failures affecting ~8,000 US environments
Reserved codeunit IDs documented in README to prevent future collisions
